statement: You are given an array prices, where prices[i] is the price of a stock on day i. You are also given an integer k.
You may make at most k trades, each a buy followed by a later sell. You can hold at most one share at a time.
Return the largest total profit you can make.

examples.explanation: Buy at 2 and sell at 6 (+4), then buy at 0 and sell at 3 (+3), for 7 in total.
With one trade allowed, buying at 1 and selling at 7 beats every other single trade.
